title: [YouPass Collect] - The amount of energy generated from wind 1985 to 2000
prompt: The chart below shows the amount of energy generated from wind in four countries from 1985 to 2000. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The bar chart illustrates the wind power generation in megawatts across four different countries over a 15-year period from 1985 to 2000.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, there was an upward trend in wind energy production in all four nations throughout the period shown. In addition, the United States and Denmark were the leading producers, with their figures experiencing the most substantial growth.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at the two dominant producers, in 1985, the United States produced approximately 1200 megawatts of wind power, which was significantly higher than Denmark's figure of around 250 megawatts. The American output then rose markedly to reach nearly 1700 megawatts in 1990, before fluctuating slightly and ending at about 1500 megawatts in 2000. Meanwhile, Denmark showed steady growth throughout the period, eventually surpassing the United States to generate roughly 1650 megawatts by 2000.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Regarding the remaining countries, Germany and India started at about 400 and 200 megawatts respectively in 1985. German production increased gradually to around 900 megawatts by the end of the period. India showed a similar pattern of growth, though at a slower pace, reaching approximately 1200 megawatts in 2000.
